templates.description: Get all core facts about a person: name, birthday, contact methods, allergies, interests, residence, and relationships.
templates.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.birthday FROM people p WHERE (:person IS NULL OR p.id = :person)

templates.description: List a person's contact methods (phone, email, etc).
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, cm.type, cm.value, cm.context FROM contact_methods cm JOIN people p ON p.id = cm.person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR cm.person_id = :person)

templates.description: List a person's relationships (family, friends, colleagues) and who they are related to.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, r.relationship, rp.name AS related_person_name FROM relationships r JOIN people p ON p.id = r.person_id JOIN people rp ON rp.id = r.related_person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR r.person_id = :person)

templates.description: List a person's allergies.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, a.allergen FROM allergies a JOIN people p ON p.id = a.person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR a.person_id = :person)

templates.description: List a person's interests/hobbies and notes about them.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, i.interest, i.notes FROM interests i JOIN people p ON p.id = i.person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR i.person_id = :person)

templates.description: List gift ideas for a person, including occasion and current status.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, g.gift_idea, g.occasion, g.occasion_date, g.status FROM gift_ideas g JOIN people p ON p.id = g.person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR g.person_id = :person)

templates.description: Find where a person lives (current and past residences with move-in date).
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, pl.name AS place_name, pl.address, pl.city, r.move_in_date FROM residences r JOIN people p ON p.id = r.person_id JOIN places pl ON pl.id = r.place_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR r.person_id = :person)

templates.description: List events/meetings scheduled or organized in a given date range, including status (scheduled/cancelled).
templates.sql: SELECT e.title, e.start_datetime, e.end_datetime, e.status, loc.name AS location_name, org.name AS organization_name, organizer.name AS organizer_name, invitee.name AS invitee_name, e.details FROM events e LEFT JOIN places loc ON loc.id = e.location_id LEFT JOIN organizations org ON org.id = e.organization_id LEFT JOIN people organizer ON organizer.id = e.organizer_person_id LEFT JOIN people invitee ON invitee.id = e.invitee_person_id WHERE e.start_datetime >= :start AND e.start_datetime <= :end ORDER BY e.start_datetime

templates.description: List all events involving a specific person (as organizer or invitee), including status.
templates.sql: SELECT e.title, e.start_datetime, e.end_datetime, e.status, loc.name AS location_name, org.name AS organization_name, organizer.name AS organizer_name, invitee.name AS invitee_name FROM events e LEFT JOIN places loc ON loc.id = e.location_id LEFT JOIN organizations org ON org.id = e.organization_id LEFT JOIN people organizer ON organizer.id = e.organizer_person_id LEFT JOIN people invitee ON invitee.id = e.invitee_person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR e.organizer_person_id = :person OR e.invitee_person_id = :person) ORDER BY e.start_datetime

templates.description: Find details about a specific event by its title, including status, location, and participants.
templates.sql: SELECT e.title, e.start_datetime, e.end_datetime, e.status, loc.name AS location_name, org.name AS organization_name, organizer.name AS organizer_name, invitee.name AS invitee_name, e.details FROM events e LEFT JOIN places loc ON loc.id = e.location_id LEFT JOIN organizations org ON org.id = e.organization_id LEFT JOIN people organizer ON organizer.id = e.organizer_person_id LEFT JOIN people invitee ON invitee.id = e.invitee_person_id WHERE (:event IS NULL OR e.id = :event)

templates.description: Total amount spent in a date range, grouped by currency.
templates.sql: SELECT ex.currency, SUM(ex.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS num_expenses FROM expenses ex WHERE ex.date >= :start AND ex.date <= :end GROUP BY ex.currency

templates.description: Spending on a specific merchant within a date range, with total and individual expenses.
templates.sql: SELECT ex.merchant, ex.description, ex.amount, ex.currency, ex.date, r.name AS restaurant_name, comp.name AS companion_name, ex.notes FROM expenses ex LEFT JOIN restaurants r ON r.id = ex.restaurant_id LEFT JOIN people comp ON comp.id = ex.companion_person_id WHERE (:merchant IS NULL OR ex.merchant = :merchant) AND ex.date >= :start AND ex.date <= :end ORDER BY ex.date

templates.description: Total amount spent per merchant, grouped by currency, across all time.
templates.sql: SELECT ex.merchant, ex.currency, SUM(ex.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS num_expenses FROM expenses ex GROUP BY ex.merchant, ex.currency ORDER BY total_amount DESC

templates.description: List all individual expenses in a date range with details (description, merchant, restaurant, companion).
templates.sql: SELECT ex.date, ex.description, ex.merchant, r.name AS restaurant_name, ex.amount, ex.currency, comp.name AS companion_name, ex.notes FROM expenses ex LEFT JOIN restaurants r ON r.id = ex.restaurant_id LEFT JOIN people comp ON comp.id = ex.companion_person_id WHERE ex.date >= :start AND ex.date <= :end ORDER BY ex.date

templates.description: List activities (climbing, running, etc) a person did in a date range, with place and companion.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, a.activity_type, a.date, pl.name AS place_name, comp.name AS companion_name, a.achievement, a.distance_km, a.duration FROM activities a JOIN people p ON p.id = a.person_id LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.id = a.place_id LEFT JOIN people comp ON comp.id = a.companion_person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR a.person_id = :person) AND a.date >= :start AND a.date <= :end ORDER BY a.date

templates.description: Count of activities by type for a person, optionally within a date range (e.g. how many times did I go climbing).
templates.sql: SELECT a.activity_type, COUNT(*) AS num_activities FROM activities a WHERE (:person IS NULL OR a.person_id = :person) AND (:start IS NULL OR a.date >= :start) AND (:end IS NULL OR a.date <= :end) GROUP BY a.activity_type

templates.description: Find the longest-distance activity (e.g. longest run) for a person, optionally of a specific type.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, a.activity_type, a.date, a.distance_km, a.duration, pl.name AS place_name FROM activities a JOIN people p ON p.id = a.person_id LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.id = a.place_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR a.person_id = :person) AND (:activity_type IS NULL OR a.activity_type = :activity_type) ORDER BY a.distance_km DESC LIMIT 1

templates.description: Find the most recent activity of a person, optionally filtered by activity type.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, a.activity_type, a.date, pl.name AS place_name, comp.name AS companion_name, a.achievement, a.distance_km, a.duration FROM activities a JOIN people p ON p.id = a.person_id LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.id = a.place_id LEFT JOIN people comp ON comp.id = a.companion_person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR a.person_id = :person) AND (:activity_type IS NULL OR a.activity_type = :activity_type) ORDER BY a.date DESC LIMIT 1

templates.description: List a person's books, reading status, ratings, and notes.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, b.title, b.author, b.status, b.rating, b.notes FROM books b JOIN people p ON p.id = b.person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR b.person_id = :person)

templates.description: List a person's vehicles, including current status and sale details if sold.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, v.make, v.model, v.year, v.license_plate, v.status, v.sold_date, v.sale_amount, v.sale_currency FROM vehicles v JOIN people p ON p.id = v.person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR v.person_id = :person)

templates.description: List a person's tasks/reminders, with due date and status.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, t.title, t.due_date, t.status FROM tasks t JOIN people p ON p.id = t.person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR t.person_id = :person) ORDER BY t.due_date

templates.description: List tasks due within a date range, with status.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, t.title, t.due_date, t.status FROM tasks t JOIN people p ON p.id = t.person_id WHERE t.due_date >= :start AND t.due_date <= :end ORDER BY t.due_date

templates.description: Get details about an organization, including status, funding stage, latest funding amount, and lead investor.
templates.sql: SELECT o.name, o.status, o.funding_stage, o.latest_funding_amount, o.latest_funding_currency, lead.name AS lead_investor_name, pl.name AS office_place_name FROM organizations o LEFT JOIN organizations lead ON lead.id = o.lead_investor_organization_id LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.id = o.office_place_id WHERE (:organization IS NULL OR o.id = :organization)

templates.description: List organizations a person belongs to, with their role, membership fee, and start date.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, o.name AS organization_name, om.role, om.monthly_fee, om.monthly_fee_currency, om.start_date FROM organization_memberships om JOIN people p ON p.id = om.person_id JOIN organizations o ON o.id = om.organization_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR om.person_id = :person)

templates.description: List all people who belong to a specific organization, with their roles.
templates.sql: SELECT o.name AS organization_name, p.name AS person_name, om.role, om.start_date FROM organization_memberships om JOIN people p ON p.id = om.person_id JOIN organizations o ON o.id = om.organization_id WHERE (:organization IS NULL OR om.organization_id = :organization)

templates.description: List emails sent or received within a date range, with sender, recipient, and subject.
templates.sql: SELECT e.sent_datetime, e.sender_email, sp.name AS sender_name, e.recipient_email, rp.name AS recipient_name, e.subject, e.body FROM emails e LEFT JOIN people sp ON sp.id = e.sender_person_id LEFT JOIN people rp ON rp.id = e.recipient_person_id WHERE e.sent_datetime >= :start AND e.sent_datetime <= :end ORDER BY e.sent_datetime

templates.description: List emails sent or received by a specific person.
templates.sql: SELECT e.sent_datetime, e.sender_email, sp.name AS sender_name, e.recipient_email, rp.name AS recipient_name, e.subject, e.body FROM emails e LEFT JOIN people sp ON sp.id = e.sender_person_id LEFT JOIN people rp ON rp.id = e.recipient_person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR e.sender_person_id = :person OR e.recipient_person_id = :person) ORDER BY e.sent_datetime

templates.description: List a person's flights, including origin, destination, dates, and cost.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, orig.name AS origin_place, dest.name AS destination_place, f.flight_date, f.airline, f.flight_number, f.amount, f.currency, f.booked_datetime FROM flights f JOIN people p ON p.id = f.person_id LEFT JOIN places orig ON orig.id = f.origin_place_id LEFT JOIN places dest ON dest.id = f.destination_place_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR f.person_id = :person) ORDER BY f.flight_date

templates.description: List a person's restaurant preferences (favorites etc), with restaurant location.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, r.name AS restaurant_name, pl.city, pl.address, rp.preference FROM restaurant_preferences rp JOIN people p ON p.id = rp.person_id JOIN restaurants r ON r.id = rp.restaurant_id LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.id = r.place_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR rp.person_id = :person)

templates.description: Find people whose birthday falls in a specific month/day text (e.g. lookup birthdays).
templates.sql: SELECT p.name, p.birthday FROM people p WHERE (:person IS NULL OR p.id = :person) AND p.birthday IS NOT NULL

templates.description: Total recurring monthly membership fees a person pays, grouped by currency.
templates.sql: SELECT p.name AS person_name, om.monthly_fee_currency, SUM(om.monthly_fee) AS total_monthly_fee FROM organization_memberships om JOIN people p ON p.id = om.person_id WHERE (:person IS NULL OR om.person_id = :person) AND om.monthly_fee IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name, om.monthly_fee_currency
